newsitem.title: USA: Arvin sees profit growth outpacing sales.
newsitem.headline: Arvin sees profit growth outpacing sales.

text.p: Arvin Industries Inc said Monday it expects its earnings growth rate for the remainder of 1997 to continue to outpace sales.
Earlier, Arvin reported second quarer earnings of $0.91 a share, up from $0.63 a year ago. Sales gained eight percent to $633 million from $583 million.

"Looking ahead to the remainder of 1997, we are expecting profits to continue rising at a faster rate than sales on a year-over-year basis," Byron Pond, chairman, said in a statement. "This represents a continuation of the pattern established over the past six quarters."
